method: Platt scaling (1D logistic regression), fit on VALIDATION ONLY (n=11, 1 positive)
critical_finding: The calibrated fusion probability on the TEST split ranges from 0.090920 to 0.090935 across all 8 samples (span < 0.00002) -- the calibrator collapsed to predicting an almost exactly constant value close to the training base rate, regardless of sample content. The near-zero Brier/ECE improvement after calibration reflects the calibrator correctly recognizing that the raw fusion score carries ~no exploitable signal at this validation sample size (n=11, 1 positive), not genuine well-calibrated discrimination. This is reported as a central, honest finding, not as evidence of a working calibrated detector.
